page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a baseline clock speed of 2.5 GHz, offering 16 dedicated virtual CPUs across 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system includes 64.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Processor instruction extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI, AES-NI, and BMI2, complemented by a 35 MB L3 cache. The instance contains zero bundled local storage and no GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached block storage, and operates with a 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a contrast between single-threaded efficiency and parallel capacity. Single-core evaluations place the instance in the lower tier, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 1001.0 and a gzip compression throughput of 19.04 GB/s. However, multi-threaded metrics remain within average ranges, recording 6324.0 on Geekbench multi-core and 13055.33 on the PassMark CPU test. Memory bandwidth reaches 75.86 GB/s for uncached 256 MB reads and 55.65 GB/s for writes. Synthetic application workloads display stable throughput, generating 11.35 million Redis SET operations per second and 9.98 GB/s in static web serving benchmarks.

From a resource utilization standpoint, the instance offers dedicated core allocation that guarantees consistent multi-core compute capacity without noisy-neighbor degradation. The absence of local NVMe storage necessitates external volume attachment, shifting I/O performance dependencies to remote block storage services. Given its balanced resource ratios and sustained multi-core performance, the hardware profile is appropriate for multi-tier web application clusters, Redis in-memory caching, backend microservices, software build pipelines, and general enterprise databases.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs (8 physical cores) powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor at 2.5 GHz and 64.0 GB of RAM. Operating on the x86_64 architecture with KVM virtualization, it provides a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and instruction extensions including AVX-512. The instance contains no bundled local storage or GPU hardware. Benchmark metrics show modest single-threaded performance offset by consistent median results across multi-core tests, such as a PassMark CPU score of 13055.33 and Geekbench multi-core score of 6324.0. Memory subsystems achieve 75.86 GB/s uncached read bandwidth, while network services demonstrate static web serving at 9.98 GB/s. This hardware configuration is suited for web serving fleets, enterprise microservices, intermediate database tasks, and in-memory key-value caching layers like Redis.
